# Write Primitives merge_full_overlap_all_update

```{tags} reference, query-template, write_primitives
```

> [Write Primitives](../../write-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Write Primitives queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
MERGE INTO merge_ops_target AS target
USING (
  SELECT
    o_orderkey,
    o_totalprice * 1.1 AS o_totalprice,
    'merge_all_update' AS o_comment
  FROM merge_ops_target
  WHERE
    o_orderkey <= (
      SELECT
        MIN(o_orderkey) + 100
      FROM merge_ops_target
    )
) AS source
ON target.o_orderkey = source.o_orderkey
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  o_totalprice = source.o_totalprice,
  o_comment = source.o_comment
```
